newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's Chekiang First Bank to launch HK$1 bln FRCD.
newsitem.headline: HK's Chekiang First Bank to launch HK$1 bln FRCD.

text.p: Hong Kong-based Chekiang First Bank will launch a HK$1.0 bln floating rate certificates of deposit issue later on Monday, a syndicate manager said.
The issuer is wholly-owned by Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank.
She said the issue will carry a maturity of three years and pays a coupon of 33 basis points over the three-month Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate.
With fees, the all-in returns for top-tier managers is 42 basis points.
The co-ordinating arrangers are DKB Asia, HSBC Markets, Schroders Asia and Bayerische Landesbank.
A group of arrangers is being sought.
Banking sources said Chekiang First Bank will apply to the Hong Kong Monetary Authority to accept the issue as eligible for its Liquidity Adjustment Facility (LAF), or discount window.
Eligibility for LAF makes an issue more attractive to banks because holders of the qualifying debt can engage in repurchase agreements with the Monetary Authority, increasing liquidity.
Chekiang First Bank is rated A-plus by IBCA.
